decisions.reason: As a low-noise variant close to the core infrared range, it likely remains useful as a differentiating option even if volumes are limited.
A gas infrared plaque heater shown on its own page fits the firm's established hall-heating business and is likely kept as a core offer.
This luminous radiant heater appears more niche, was only briefly mentioned, and is more exposed to portfolio simplification and the firm's push toward efficient low-emission solutions.
A gas-fired infrared tube heater line with several models suggests broader investment and customer coverage, making discontinuation unlikely in the near term.
The standard gas infrared plaque heater likely serves as an entry-level mainstream product, so it is still worth keeping despite overlap with other plaque heaters.
Because it overlaps strongly with the broader tube-heater line in product D and was only mentioned rather than emphasized, it is the most likely candidate for withdrawal.
